reported.headline: Amazon.com reported revenue of $46.2 billion, up 20% from the same quarter a year earlier.
Apple reported revenue of $9.8 billion, up 15% from the same quarter a year earlier.
Microsoft reported revenue of $43.1 billion, up 17% from the same quarter a year earlier.

NVIDIA reported revenue of $18.9 billion, up 7% from the same quarter a year earlier.
